items.html: And after the first man sinned with the Tree of Knowledge, which is the world of Assiyah — for he was commanded not to eat of it, because he has no share in Assiyah, only from Yetzirah and above, as above — and since he transgressed and ate of the Tree of Knowledge, which is Assiyah, he caused a blemish in all the worlds, and all of them descended from their degree, in this manner: Yetzirah clothed in Assiyah.
